summary: Perdoceo Education Corp filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of South University Savannah, LLC from nonprofit seller South University Member, Inc. Initial cash consideration is $150 million at closing, subject to working-capital and debt adjustments as of April 2027, plus $18 million deferred cash over 24 months and up to $56 million in EBITDA-linked earn-outs for fiscal 2027-2029, funded from cash. South generated roughly $291 million 2025 revenue and $34 million adjusted operating income, serving about 10,500 students; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch regulatory/accreditation approvals and earn-out thresholds.
